headline: Continued 865 South Prospect Street permit, approved 275-277 Flynn Avenue subdivision, deferred 45 Howard Street addition, and appointed new DRB Chair and Vice Chair.
summary: The board continued a home occupation permit at 865 South Prospect Street and approved a two-lot subdivision at 275-277 Flynn Avenue. It deferred a Certificate of Appropriateness for 45 Howard Street and closed hearings on a food stand permit at 56 Woodbury Road and a tree-clearing case at 246 Riverside Ave for later deliberation. The board also held its annual organizational meeting, appointing a new Chair, Vice Chair, and committee representatives.
decisions: Continued the ZP-26-252 application for 865 South Prospect Street to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, vote 5-0.
Approved the ZP-26-133 two-lot subdivision at 275-277 Flynn Avenue, vote 5-0.
Deferred the ZP-26-28 Certificate of Appropriateness for 45 Howard Street to the 8/4/26 DRB meeting, vote 5-0.
Appointed Caitlin Halpert as Chair of the Development Review Board, vote 6-0.
Appointed Evan Gould as Vice Chair of the Development Review Board, vote 6-0.
Appointed Evan Gould as representative to the Long Range Planning Committee, vote 6-0.
Appointed Miles Waite as representative to the Planning Commission Ordinance Committee, vote 6-0.
